description: The safety gate between the detector and the advisory.

cases.why: No model means no diagnosis. This returns immediately and must never reach the other rules.

reasons.action: Send the photograph to your Taluka Agriculture Officer or KVK for a human diagnosis. Do not spray on the basis of this app alone.

reasons.message: The model found no symptom it recognises above the confidence threshold. This may mean a healthy crop, a poor photograph, or a problem outside the three potato classes it was trained on.
reasons.action: Retake the photo in daylight, filling the frame with the affected leaf. If symptoms are visible to you, refer the case to an extension officer.

reasons.action: Have an extension officer inspect the field before choosing a chemistry - the wrong product here wastes money and leaves residue for no benefit.
